data.long_meaning: Mariella is a name of Hebrew and Greek origin that can be traced back to the Bible and early Christian history. In Hebrew, it is derived from the name Maryellah, which means 'rebellion' or 'rebelliousness to God'. In Greek, it is derived from the name Mariēlla, which means 'a bitter sea'. In Christian tradition, the name Mariella is associated with the story of Mary Magdalene, who was known for her tears of repentance and her devotion to Jesus. It is also said to symbolize the bitterness of sin and the sweetness of redemption.
